parts.t: Mission townhomes under $1.2M deliver exceptional Fraser Valley value with modern construction, mountain views, and outdoor lifestyle access. These properties attract first-time buyers, young families, and downsizers seeking quality living without single-family home maintenance or pricing. The market includes options from compact two-bedroom units perfect for singles or couples to spacious family-sized townhomes with multiple bedrooms and attached garages.

Residents appreciate Mission's natural beauty with hiking and water sports minutes away, genuine small-town atmosphere, plus improving amenities including downtown revitalization. Many complexes feature contemporary designs, open layouts, and amenities like playgrounds or green spaces enhancing community living. The area's affordability compared to Metro Vancouver, combined with reasonable Highway 7 commuting, makes Mission increasingly popular for those balancing lifestyle and budget. Excellent schools and recreation facilities serve families well, while the relaxed pace appeals to all ages. Ready to explore Mission townhomes?
